focus_areas.area: CloudTrail event sources and API call logging
Alert recipients (email, Slack, incident response systems)
Critical security event detection (root account usage, IAM changes)

rule.title: Root Account Usage Not Detected
rule.description: CloudTrail should track root account usage with immediate alert
rule.action: Verify CloudTrail logs root console signin and API calls
Check EventBridge rule exists for root account activity

rule.title: IAM Policy Changes Not Alerted
rule.description: IAM policy changes enable privilege escalation, need immediate alert
rule.action: Check CloudTrail logs PutUserPolicy, AttachUserPolicy, AttachGroupPolicy

rule.title: CloudTrail Not Enabled
rule.description: CloudTrail must be enabled to log API calls for alert triggers
rule.action: Verify CloudTrail IsLogging == true and trail exists

rule.title: EventBridge Rules Missing
rule.description: EventBridge (CloudWatch Events) rules forward events to alerts
rule.action: Check for rules targeting SNS topic for security events

rule.title: SNS Topic Not Configured
rule.description: SNS topic must be configured to distribute alerts to recipients
rule.action: Verify SNS topic exists and has subscriptions (email, Slack, etc.)

rule.title: Alert Recipients Missing
rule.description: Alerts must reach on-call security team, not just logged
rule.action: Verify SNS topic has email/SMS/Slack subscriptions
Confirm recipients are active and monitored

rule.title: Unencrypted SNS Communication
rule.description: SNS topics should enforce HTTPS and encryption
rule.action: Check SNS policy requires HTTPS (no HTTP)

rule.title: No Escalation for Missed Alerts
rule.description: If primary alert fails, escalation path must exist
rule.action: Verify fallback alert mechanism (email + Slack + SMS)

focus.check: IAM API calls: PutUserPolicy, AttachUserPolicy, AttachGroupPolicy
Rules matching root account activity patterns
Target: SNS topic for alert distribution
Subscriptions list (email, Slack webhook, HTTP endpoint)
Lambda subscriptions: function exists and active
HTTP(S) endpoints: Slack webhooks, incident response systems
Log groups exist for CloudTrail and EventBridge
Alarms trigger SNS topic when metrics exceed threshold

flow.step_1: CloudTrail → Logs all API calls (root, IAM, security)
flow.step_2: EventBridge Rules → Match patterns (root login, policy change, etc.)
flow.step_4: SNS Subscriptions → Distribute to: - Email (primary) - Slack (team visibility) - SMS (critical alerts) - Lambda (custom processing) - HTTP endpoint (incident response system)
flow.step_5: Alert Recipients → Security team responds within SLA

criterion.name: end_to_end_alert
criterion.description: Alert must flow from CloudTrail → EventBridge → SNS → Email/Slack
criterion.metric: Trigger security event and verify all steps execute

criterion.name: alert_latency
criterion.description: Alert should reach team within 5-10 minutes of event
criterion.metric: Measure time from event to email/Slack receipt

criterion.name: alert_accuracy
criterion.description: Alerts must be actionable (no false positives)
criterion.metric: Define EventBridge patterns to exclude noise

criterion.name: recipient_availability
criterion.metric: Verify on-call rotation and escalation path
